notes: The colophon names no persons. The scribe speaks only in the first person, in the stock yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā verse ('liṣitaṃ mayā'). The date (Śaka 1646, Caitra) matches the catalogue field. ŚS 1646 is about 1724–25 CE: Caitra 1646 falls in March–April 1724 if the Śaka year is counted from Caitra.
